description: TrafficLight surface drawn (simplest drivable state). DI_AEC_TrafficLight_Show (diAEControl.cpp L245-255) sets sta_trafficLightStatus=RET_SHOW when first_Cross_light_status_S not in {0,1}, val_display!=SIMPLE, sta_Navi==NAVI_ON, sta_vehicleConditionShow!=RET_SHOW. first_Cross_light_status_S loaded (L164) from EventSignal.FirstCrosslightstatusS (First_Cross_light_status_S CAN callback, 0x43F 2.2-2.4); feed value 2. val_display=1 (STANDARD), gear!=1 keeps the display/speed gates open. sta_Navi==NAVI_ON needs POWER_ON(val_power=3) and val_naviStatus in {2,3}; navigation channel online via someip 0x010A/0x01. Primary label asserted.

can.desc: gear!=1 keeps sta_vehicleConditionShow=RET_SHOW_NOT, opening the show gate

someip.desc: navigation ETH channel online so DiDcGetNavigationETH returns non-zero navigating_status
